card.title: Subscribe to the calendar
card.description: Add this link to your calendar app to see term dates, holidays and events, and get updates automatically.

field.label: Your personal subscribe link
field.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Select and copy it manually.

regenerate.confirmDescription: Your old link stops working right away. Any calendar app still using it will need the new link below.

howTo.title: How to subscribe
howTo.google: Google Calendar: "Other calendars" → "+" → "From URL", then paste the link.
howTo.apple: Apple Calendar: File → "New Calendar Subscription", then paste the link.
howTo.outlook: Outlook: "Add calendar" → "Subscribe from web", then paste the link.
